Guard u by original wrapDist > 0, with default 1. Initialize new outputs on early cull without reading existing uninitialized outputs.
Variant OFF must preserve exact current shader interface and math; ON adds shader preparation only. No new CPU uniforms, registration, per-frame ownership, or math mode changes.
Source does not prove byte parity across stage transfer: rounding, signed zero, NaN/Inf, degenerate triangles and acceptance edges require validation.
